8B.19.eg: Pre- & post-fumigation statements from the fumigator-in-charge.
ex: Pre- and post-fumigation statements from the fumigator.
Checks accommodation and ER are gas-free
8B.19.fg: Pre- at post-fumigation statements mula sa fumigator-in-charge.
fc: Naka-file ang statements; kinumpirmang gas-free ang accommodation/ER
fx: Pre- at post-fumigation statements mula sa fumigator.
Chine-check kung gas-free ang accommodation at ER

8B.20.eg: Warning signs/marking at entrances to fumigated spaces.
ex: Signs so that nobody enters spaces with fumigant.
8B.20.fg: Warning signs/marka sa pasukan ng fumigated spaces.
fc: Warning signs sa hold access hatches at katabing spaces
fx: May signs para walang pumasok sa spaces na may fumigant.

8B.21.eg: Voyage Safety Plan & fumigation checklist signed.
ex: Voyage Safety Plan signed by the Master before sailing.
8B.21.fg: May pirma ang Voyage Safety Plan at fumigation checklist.
fc: VSP may pirma ng Master bago umalis
fx: Voyage Safety Plan na may pirma ng Master bago umalis.

8B.22.eg: A/C intakes set so they do not draw in fumigant.
ex: Air intakes set so they do not draw in fumigant.
8B.22.fg: Naka-set ang A/C intakes para hindi humigop ng fumigant.
fc: A/C naka-recirculation; isinaalang-alang ang ER intakes
fx: Naka-set ang air intakes para hindi humigop ng fumigant.

8B.23.eg: Procedure for entering sealed fumigated holds.
8B.23.fg: Procedure sa pagpasok sa sealed fumigated holds.
fc: Emergency entry procedure na may BA at gas test
fx: Procedure sa pagpasok sa sealed holds.

8B.24.eg: Notification to destination authorities about fumigation.
ex: Notice to the destination authorities about the fumigation.
8B.24.fg: Abiso sa awtoridad ng destinasyon tungkol sa fumigation.
fc: Naka-file ang notification message (≥24h bago dumating)
fx: Abiso sa awtoridad ng destinasyon tungkol sa fumigation.

8B.25.eg: Gas-free certificate or safety measures at the discharge port.
ex: Gas-free certificate at the discharge port, or safety measures.
8B.25.fg: Gas-free certificate o safety measures sa discharge port.
fc: Gas-free cert o ventilation at monitoring records
fx: Gas-free certificate sa discharge port o safety measures.

fc: Gas readings log habang naglalayag

ex: Dew point instruments with spare, calibrated.
8B.27.fg: Calibrated ang dew point instruments (may spare).
fc: Hygrometer/psychrometer + spare, calibration records
fx: Dew point instruments na may spare, calibrated.

ex: Hold ventilation, where needed, with records.
8B.29.fg: Naka-record ang hold ventilation (dew point rule).
fc: Ventilation log na may dew point readings
fx: Hold ventilation, kung kailangan, may records.

8B.30.eg: Grain stability calculation of the last voyage satisfactory.
ex: A satisfactory grain stability calculation for the last voyage.
Checks stowage factor, hold volumes, partly filled holds
8B.30.fg: Maayos ang grain stability calculation ng huling voyage.
fc: Grain heeling moments na may tamang SF at full volumes; tamang trato sa partly-filled holds
Pasado ang criteria: angle of heel ≤12°, residual dynamic stability, GM
fx: Maayos ang grain stability calculation para sa huling voyage.
Chine-check ang stowage factor, volume ng holds, partly filled

fc: Gaya ng 8A.14

8B.32.eg: Bilges clean, bilge covers grain-tight (burlap), all openings grain-tight.
ex: Bilges clean and all openings grain-tight.
8B.32.fg: Malinis ang bilges, grain-tight ang bilge covers (burlap), grain-tight lahat ng openings.
fc: Malinis ang bilge wells at natakpan ng burlap/cement-sealed
Grain tight ang hold openings
fx: Malinis ang bilges at grain-tight lahat ng openings.

8B.33.eg: Cargo hold lights isolated before loading – records.
ex: Records that hold lights were isolated before loading.
Writes the safety measures in the comments
8B.33.fg: Naka-isolate ang cargo hold lights bago magkarga – may records.
fc: Isolation records ng hold lights (panganib ng sunog sa grain dust)
fx: Records na na-isolate ang ilaw ng holds bago magkarga.
Isinusulat sa comments ang safety measures

fc: Gaya ng 8A.15

8B.35.eg: Grain O2 depletion: precautions for hold entry.
ex: Knowledge of the risk of O2 depletion with grain.
8B.35.fg: O2 depletion sa grain: pag-iingat sa pagpasok sa hold.
fc: Gaya ng 8A.17
fx: Kaalaman sa panganib ng kulang na O2 sa grain.

9A.1.eg: Holds and hatch cover undersides without loose rust scale & paint flakes.
ex: Holds and hatch cover undersides without loose rust and flaking paint.
9A.1.fg: Holds at ilalim ng hatch covers na walang maluwag na kalawang at natuklap na pintura.
fc: I-inspect ang hold walls, frames, hoppers at ilalim ng covers para sa maluwag na kalawang
Tuktukin/walisin ang maluwag na kalawang bago ang inspection kung may oras
fx: Holds at ilalim ng hatch covers na walang maluwag na kalawang at natuklap na pintura.
ff: Maluwag na kalawang at natuklap na pintura sa holds at ilalim ng hatch cover

9A.2.eg: Procedure for operating/inspecting hatch covers; Master/C/O training.
ex: A procedure for operating and inspecting hatch covers, training of Master/C/O.
9A.2.fg: Procedure sa pag-operate/pag-inspect ng hatch covers; training ng Master/C/O.
fc: Hatch cover manual at procedure; training certificate (maker/company) ng Master at C/O
fx: May procedure sa pag-operate at pag-inspect ng hatch covers, training ng Master/C/O.
ff: Hindi nasusukat bawat 6 buwan ang clearances ng hatch cover components / walang spare parts list

9A.3.eg: Hose/ultrasonic tests of hatch covers with evidence.
ex: Procedures for hose or ultrasonic test, with evidence.
9A.3.fg: Hose/ultrasonic tests ng hatch covers na may patunay.
fc: Hose test / UT records (may picture) ayon sa SMS interval
Inayos at sinubukan ulit ang leaks
fx: May procedures para sa hose o ultrasonic test, may patunay.
ff: Hindi nagawa o hindi naka-record ang hose / UT test ng hatch covers bago ang huling cargo

9A.4.eg: Compression bars & water channels clean, without corrosion.
ex: Compression bars and coaming water channels clean and without corrosion.
9A.4.fg: Malinis at walang kalawang ang compression bars at water channels.
fc: Tuwid at hindi bulok ang compression bars, walang pintura/kalawang
Malinis ang channels, walang cargo residue
fx: Malinis at walang kalawang ang compression bars at water channels ng coaming.
ff: Baluktot o kalawangin ang compression bars / hindi malinis ang water channels

9A.5.eg: Drain holes clear, non-return valves OK, no rust streaks inside the coaming.
ex: Drain holes clear, non-return valves in good condition, no vertical rust streaks inside the coaming.
9A.5.fg: Malinis ang drain holes, OK ang non-return valves, walang bakas ng kalawang sa loob ng coaming.
fc: Malinis ang coaming drains; may non-return balls/flaps at malayang gumagalaw
Walang patayong mantsa ng kalawang sa loob ng coaming (palatandaan ng leak)
fx: Malinis ang drain holes, maayos ang non-return valves, walang patayong bakas ng kalawang sa loob ng coaming.
ff: Barado ang drain channels, walang non-return valves
Bakas ng kalawang sa loob ng coaming na palatandaan ng leak

9A.6.eg: Quick-acting cleats all in place, washers flexible, unpainted.
ex: All cleats in place, with flexible washers and no paint.
9A.6.fg: Kumpleto ang quick-acting cleats, malambot ang washers, walang pintura.
fc: Kumpleto at gumagana ang cleats; malambot ang rubber washers, walang pintura/bitak
Tama ang adjustment nuts ng cleats
fx: Kumpleto ang cleats, may malambot na washers na walang pintura.
ff: Kulang, naninigas o may pintura ang quick-acting cleats / tumigas ang washers

9A.7.eg: Steel-to-steel contact: coaming tops without grooving/wear.
9A.7.fg: Steel-to-steel contact: walang uka/pagkasira ang coaming tops.
fc: I-check ang coaming tops para sa pagkasira/uka
fx: Steel-to-steel: walang pagkasira ang coaming tops.

fc: Buo ang bearing pads, hindi sira/kulang

9A.9.eg: Side & cross-joint rubber seals: no permanent set, tears or paint.
9A.9.fg: Side at cross-joint rubber seals: walang permanent set, punit o pintura.
fc: Rubber packing: walang punit, permanent set >50%, pagtigas o pintura
Magkadikit ang dugtungan ng packing, walang puwang
ff: Rubber packing na may permanent set, punit o may pintura / hindi dumidikit sa compression bar

fc: Pantay ang pagsara ng panels; walang misalignment sa cross joints

9A.11.fg: Seal retaining channels na walang kalawang.
fc: Buo ang channels, walang pagkabulok sa likod ng goma
fx: Seal retaining channels na walang kalawang.

9A.12.eg: Cross-joint channels & compression bar straight, brackets OK.
ex: Cross-joint channels and compression bar straight, without damage.
9A.12.fg: Tuwid ang cross-joint channels at compression bar, OK ang brackets.
fc: I-check na tuwid at buo ang cross-joints
fx: Tuwid at walang sira ang cross-joint channels at compression bar.

9A.13.eg: Wheels, tracks, hydraulics & hoses, chains, pins, cylinders, stoppers in good condition.
ex: Wheels, tracks, hydraulics, chains, pins in good condition.
With Master's agreement, asks to remove the wrapping from random hydraulic hoses
9A.13.fg: Maayos ang wheels, tracks, hydraulics at hoses, chains, pins, cylinders, stoppers.
fc: Malayang umiikot ang wheels/bearings; malinis ang trackways
Hydraulic hoses: walang leak, hindi expired; puwedeng tanggalin ng inspector ang protective wrapping nang random
Chains, link pins, safety pins, cylinders, securing devices
Mag-operate ng isang hatch cover sa harap mo
fx: Maayos ang wheels, tracks, hydraulics, chains, pins.
Kung payag ang Master, ipinatatanggal ang wrapping ng random na hydraulic hoses
ff: Hydraulic leaks sa hatch cover cylinders at pipes
Sira o walang grasa ang wheels, chains, pins

ex: Cross-joint wedges in place and working.
9A.14.fg: Nasa lugar at gumagana ang cross-joint wedges.
fc: Kumpleto ang wedges at kumakapit
fx: Nasa lugar at gumagana ang cross-joint wedges.
